lede: Missouri carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.7 against -1.3, a 7.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Arkansas +9.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Missouri winning 73% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 85% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
